title: Review these changes
inputs: the diff or file(s) to review
the criteria to check against, if any were stated
steps: read the diff/change in full before judging any part of it
check it against the stated review criteria (or, if none were given, correctness/safety/simplification/efficiency/test-coverage)
for each candidate finding, verify it against the actual code — never report a finding you have not re-checked in the real file
report findings, most severe first, each with the concrete failure scenario it causes
success_conditions: every reported finding was verified against the real diff, not just described from memory
findings are ordered most severe first
